definitionZh: :只有孩子的CSS假类代表一个没有兄弟姐妹的元素. 这与:第一胎:最后胎或:nth-child(1):nth-最后胎(1)相同,但特异性较低.
sourceDefinition: The :only-child CSS pseudo-class represents an element without any siblings. This is the same as :first-child:last-child or :nth-child(1):nth-last-child(1), but with a lower specificity.
